model.name: gemma-4-31b
model.about: Google Gemma 4, 31B dense, BF16 as released. Apache-2.0. Matched to the October gemma-4-26b retest: vLLM 0.31.0, Gemma tool/reasoning parsers and tool chat template, explicit non-thinking requests, no free JSON whitespace. Run --quick before a full benchmark; the Gemma 4 family previously exhibited repetition under strict JSON.

answers.sql:
SELECT
    t2.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t1
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL t2
    ON t1.CHNL_K = t2.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT t3
    ON t1.BUS_DT_K = t3.DT_K
WHERE t3.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY 1
SELECT count(*) AS active_customer_count FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE AND IS_ACTV = TRUE;

SELECT t2.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction, COUNT(t1.AML_ALRT_F_K) AS alert_count FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT t1 JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR t2 ON t1.JUR_K = t2.JUR_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT t3 ON t1.BUS_DT_K = t3.DT_K WHERE t3.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY t2.DSPLY_NM

SELECT
    b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    COUNT(a.ATM_TXN_F_K) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b
    ON a.BR_K = b.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY b.DSPLY_NM
SELECT count(*) FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT count(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS client_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 8
  AND d.IS_MTH_END = TRUE
  AND f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT
    ctg.dsply_nm AS complaint_category,
    COUNT(f.cmplt_f_k) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.f_cmplt f
JOIN bank_dwh.d_cmplt_ctg ctg
    ON f.cmplt_ctg_k = ctg.cmplt_ctg_k
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt dt
    ON f.bus_dt_k = dt.dt_k
WHERE dt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP BY 1

SELECT
    f.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
    AVG(f.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_fx_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT
    f.MKT_ID,
    SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_portfolio_valuation
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.MKT_ID;

DELETE FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE CUST_K IN (
    SELECT CUST_K
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            CUST_K, 
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BUS_ID ORDER BY UPD_AT DESC, CUST_K DESC) as rn
        FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
    ) t
    WHERE t.rn > 1
);

SELECT
  ACCT_TYP_CD1,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ACCT_NBR_HSH) AS account_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE
  OPND_DT >= '2025-01-01'
  AND OPND_DT <= '2025-12-31'
  AND IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY
  ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT
    br.cty_nm,
    COUNT(atm.atm_txn_f_k) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.f_atm_txn atm
JOIN bank_dwh.d_br br
    ON atm.br_k = br.br_k
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt dt
    ON atm.bus_dt_k = dt.dt_k
WHERE
    dt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
    AND dt.qtr_nbr = 1
GROUP BY
    br.cty_nm;

SELECT AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(fx.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fx.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE fx.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dt.MTH_NBR = 12;

SELECT d.MTH_NBR, COUNT(*) AS dispute_count FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR

SELECT
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY 1;

SELECT count(DISTINCT d.cust_k)
FROM bank_dwh.d_cust d
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bank_dwh.f_acct_txn f
    JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt dt ON f.bus_dt_k = dt.dt_k
    WHERE f.cust_k = d.cust_k
      AND dt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
)

SELECT
  100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN f.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*)
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
  ctg.dsply_nm AS complaint_category_name,
  COUNT(f.cmplt_f_k) AS escalated_complaints_count
FROM bank_dwh.f_cmplt f
JOIN bank_dwh.d_cmplt_ctg ctg
  ON f.cmplt_ctg_k = ctg.cmplt_ctg_k
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt dt
  ON f.bus_dt_k = dt.dt_k
WHERE
  f.is_esclt = TRUE
  AND dt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP BY
  ctg.dsply_nm

SELECT sum(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_transaction_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
  j.dsply_nm AS jurisdiction_name,
  COUNT(f.aml_alrt_f_k) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.f_aml_alrt f
JOIN bank_dwh.d_jur j
  ON f.jur_k = j.jur_k
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt d
  ON f.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE f.alrt_svrty_cd1 = 'HIGH'
  AND d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP BY
  j.dsply_nm
ORDER BY
  alert_count DESC;

SELECT count(DISTINCT f.LN_ID)
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-08-31'
  AND f.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_FEE f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025) AND f.CHNL_K = (SELECT CHNL_K FROM bank_dwh.D_BR WHERE DSPLY_NM = 'Mobile App' LIMIT 1) GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR

SELECT
    p.dsply_nm AS loan_product_name,
    SUM(f.otstn_prncp_amt) AS total_outstanding_loan_principal
FROM bank_dwh.f_ln_dlq_d f
JOIN bank_dwh.d_ln_prd p ON f.ln_prd_k = p.ln_prd_k
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt d ON f.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE d.cal_dt = '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY p.dsply_nm;

SELECT count(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS distinct_customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

WITH BranchTxnCount AS (
    SELECT 
        br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
        br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
        COUNT(*) AS txn_count,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY br.RGN_CD1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rnk
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN txn
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON txn.BR_K = br.BR_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY br.RGN_CD1, br.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT 
    region_code, 
    branch_name, 
    txn_count
FROM BranchTxnCount
WHERE rnk = 1;

SELECT f.MRCH_CTG_CD1, SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_auth_amount FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_RWD_ERN f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY f.MRCH_CTG_CD1 ORDER BY total_auth_amount DESC LIMIT 3;

SELECT c.bus_id, SUM(f.stlm_amt) AS total_wire_amount
FROM bank_dwh.f_wr_trf f
JOIN bank_dwh.d_cust c ON f.cust_k = c.cust_k
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt d ON f.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP BY c.bus_id
ORDER BY total_wire_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    f.ccy_cd1,
    SUM(f.orgnl_amt) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.f_wr_trf f
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt d ON f.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP BY f.ccy_cd1;

SELECT count(DISTINCT atm.CUST_K)
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN atm
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_atm ON atm.BUS_DT_K = d_atm.DT_K
WHERE d_atm.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
AND atm.CUST_K IN (
    SELECT wr.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_wr ON wr.BUS_DT_K = d_wr.DT_K
    WHERE d_wr.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT count(*) AS wire_transfer_count FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
    t2.cal_yr_nbr AS year,
    COUNT(*) AS transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.f_wr_trf t1
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt t2
    ON t1.bus_dt_k = t2.dt_k
WHERE t2.cal_yr_nbr IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY t2.cal_yr_nbr
ORDER BY t2.cal_yr_nbr;

/* Note: Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) is not a pre-calculated column in the provided schema. Assuming CLV is based on the ESTMT_ASSTS_AMT (Estimated Assets Amount) for current active customers. */
SELECT 
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
    AVG(ESTMT_ASSTS_AMT) AS avg_customer_lifetime_value
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1;
null
DROP TABLE bank_dwh.F_CMPLT;
SELECT DSPLY_NM FROM bank_dwh.D_BR;

INSERT INTO bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D (BUS_DT_K, CCY_CD1, MID_RT)
SELECT 
    d.DT_K,
    'USD',
    1.10
FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-12-31';

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.is_wknd = TRUE) AS weekend_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.is_wknd = FALSE) AS weekday_count
FROM bank_dwh.f_atm_txn f
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt d ON f.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025;

WITH balance_snapshots AS (
    SELECT 
        f.ACCT_K,
        MAX(CASE WHEN d.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30' THEN f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT END) as balance_june,
        MAX(CASE WHEN d.CAL_DT = '2025-12-31' THEN f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT END) as balance_dec
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_DT IN ('2025-06-30', '2025-12-31')
    GROUP BY f.ACCT_K
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*)
FROM balance_snapshots
WHERE balance_june IS NOT NULL 
  AND balance_dec IS NOT NULL
  AND balance_dec < (balance_june * 0.9);

SELECT 
    cat.CMPLT_CTG_NM, 
    AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (f.RSLTN_AT - f.CNTCT_STRTD_AT)) / 86400) AS avg_days_to_resolution
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG cat ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = cat.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.IS_RSLVD = TRUE
GROUP BY cat.CMPLT_CTG_NM

SELECT count(*) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST curr
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST prev ON curr.BUS_ID = prev.BUS_ID
WHERE curr.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND prev.VRSN_NBR = curr.VRSN_NBR - 1
  AND curr.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 <> prev.CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

SELECT count(DISTINCT f_disp.CUST_K)
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f_disp
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_disp ON f_disp.BUS_DT_K = d_disp.DT_K
WHERE d_disp.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
AND f_disp.CUST_K NOT IN (
    SELECT f_wire.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f_wire
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_wire ON f_wire.BUS_DT_K = d_wire.DT_K
    WHERE d_wire.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)

WITH loan_status AS (
    SELECT 
        f.LN_ID, 
        d.CAL_DT,
        f.DYS_PST_DUE
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_DT IN ('2024-06-30', '2025-06-30')
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.LN_ID)
FROM loan_status t1
JOIN loan_status t2 ON t1.LN_ID = t2.LN_ID
WHERE t1.CAL_DT = '2024-06-30' 
  AND t1.DYS_PST_DUE = 0
  AND t2.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30' 
  AND t2.DYS_PST_DUE > 30;

SELECT 
    f.CCY_CD1,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY f.ORGNL_AMT) AS median_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1;
null

WITH MonthlyLastSnapshot AS (
    SELECT 
        d.MTH_NBR,
        MAX(d.DT_K) as LAST_DT_K
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT 
    mls.MTH_NBR,
    SUM(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) as TOTAL_CLOSING_BALANCE
FROM MonthlyLastSnapshot mls
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f ON mls.LAST_DT_K = f.BUS_DT_K
GROUP BY mls.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY mls.MTH_NBR;

SELECT
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE '2023-06-30' >= EFF_FRM_DT
  AND '2023-06-30' < EFF_TO_DT
GROUP BY
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment_code,
        c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id,
        SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_amount
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        segment_code,
        customer_business_id,
        total_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment_code ORDER BY total_amount DESC) as rank_pos
    FROM customer_totals
)
SELECT 
    segment_code,
    customer_business_id,
    total_amount
FROM ranked_customers
WHERE rank_pos <= 3
ORDER BY segment_code, total_amount DESC;

SELECT
    f.ccy_cd1 AS currency_code,
    (COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER()) AS percentage
FROM bank_dwh.f_wr_trf f
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt d ON f.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP BY f.ccy_cd1

SELECT
    d.MTH_NBR,
    COUNT(f.WR_TRF_F_K) AS wire_transfer_count,
    SUM(COUNT(f.WR_TRF_F_K)) OVER (ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR) AS running_total
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN t.ORGNL_AMT
            ELSE t.ORGNL_AMT / fx.MID_RT
        END
    ) AS total_wire_transfer_amount_eur
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx ON t.BUS_DT_K = fx.BUS_DT_K 
    AND t.CCY_K = fx.CCY_K 
    AND fx.QUOT_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR'
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT
    d.MTH_NBR,
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN f.AUTH_RSLT_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS declined_share_percentage
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY declined_share_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d_ccy.ccy_nm, SUM(f_wr_trf.orgnl_amt) AS total_volume
FROM bank_dwh.f_wr_trf
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt ON f_wr_trf.bus_dt_k = d_dt.dt_k
JOIN bank_dwh.d_ccy ON f_wr_trf.ccy_k = d_ccy.ccy_k
WHERE d_dt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP BY d_ccy.ccy_nm

SELECT t1.dsply_nm AS channel_name, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.f_acct_txn t0
JOIN bank_dwh.d_chnl t1 ON t0.chnl_k = t1.chnl_k
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt t2 ON t0.bus_dt_k = t2.dt_k
WHERE t2.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP BY t1.dsply_nm
SELECT count(*) AS active_customer_count FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE AND IS_ACTV = TRUE;

SELECT t2.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction, COUNT(t1.AML_ALRT_F_K) AS alert_count FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT t1 JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR t2 ON t1.JUR_K = t2.JUR_K JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT t3 ON t1.BUS_DT_K = t3.DT_K WHERE t3.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 GROUP BY t2.DSPLY_NM

SELECT
  br.dsply_nm AS branch_name,
  COUNT(atm.atm_txn_f_k) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.f_atm_txn atm
JOIN bank_dwh.d_br br
  ON atm.br_k = br.br_k
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt dt
  ON atm.bus_dt_k = dt.dt_k
WHERE dt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP BY 1
SELECT count(*) FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT count(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS default_client_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 8
  AND d.IS_MTH_END = TRUE
  AND f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT
  cat.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
  COUNT(fact.CMPLT_F_K) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT fact
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG cat
  ON fact.CMPLT_CTG_K = cat.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  ON fact.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY 1

SELECT
    f.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
    AVG(f.AVRG_RT) AS average_daily_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT
    f.MKT_ID,
    SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_portfolio_valuation
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.MKT_ID;

DELETE FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE CUST_K IN (
    SELECT CUST_K
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            CUST_K, 
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BUS_ID ORDER BY INGST_AT DESC, CUST_K DESC) as rn
        FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
    ) t
    WHERE t.rn > 1
);

SELECT
    ACCT_TYP_CD1,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ACCT_NBR_HSH) AS account_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE
    OPND_DT >= '2025-01-01'
    AND OPND_DT <= '2025-12-31'
    AND IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY
    ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT
    br.cty_nm,
    COUNT(txn.atm_txn_f_k) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.f_atm_txn txn
JOIN bank_dwh.d_br br
    ON txn.br_k = br.br_k
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt dt
    ON txn.bus_dt_k = dt.dt_k
WHERE
    dt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
    AND dt.qtr_nbr = 1
GROUP BY
    br.cty_nm

SELECT AVG(f.clsng_bal_amt) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.f_acct_bal_d f
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt d ON f.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE d.cal_dt = '2025-06-30';
SELECT AVG(f.mid_rt) AS average_mid_rate FROM bank_dwh.f_fx_rt_d f JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt d ON f.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k WHERE f.ccy_cd1 = 'USD' AND d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025 AND d.mth_nbr = 12

SELECT

SELECT

SELECT count(DISTINCT c.CUST_K) AS customer_count

    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K

SELECT

FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT

null

SELECT

SELECT

  j.dsply_nm;

SELECT count(DISTINCT f.LN_ID)

JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-08-31'

SELECT
  p.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,

FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K

WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY 1

SELECT count(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS distinct_customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f

JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K

WITH branch_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
        br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY br.RGN_CD1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rnk
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN txn

    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY br.RGN_CD1, br.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT 
    region_code,
    branch_name,
    transaction_count
FROM branch_counts
WHERE rnk = 1;

SELECT

FROM bank_dwh.f_cd_rwd_ern f
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt d ON f.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
    c.bus_id,

FROM bank_dwh.f_wr_trf f
JOIN bank_dwh.d_cust c
    ON f.cust_k = c.cust_k
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt d
    ON f.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE
    d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP BY
    c.bus_id
ORDER BY
    total_wire_transfer_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    f.ccy_cd1,
    SUM(f.orgnl_amt) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.f_wr_trf f
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt d ON f.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP BY f.ccy_cd1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atm.CUST_K)
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN atm
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt_atm ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt_atm.DT_K
WHERE dt_atm.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
AND atm.CUST_K IN (
    SELECT wr.CUST_K

    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt_wr ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt_wr.DT_K

)
SELECT count(*) AS wire_transfer_count FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.cal_yr_nbr AS year, COUNT(f.wr_trf_f_k) AS wire_transfer_count FROM bank_dwh.f_wr_trf f JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt d ON f.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY d.cal_yr_nbr ORDER BY d.cal_yr_nbr;

/* Assumption: No employee-specific table provided; using customer table's annual income as a proxy for employee salary. Using current versions of branch and customer dimensions. */
SELECT
    br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    AVG(cust.ANNL_INCM_AMT) AS average_salary
FROM bank_dwh.D_BR br
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D fact ON br.BR_K = fact.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST cust ON fact.CUST_K = cust.CUST_K

GROUP BY br.DSPLY_NM

                            UPD_AT DESC

SELECT dsply_nm FROM bank_dwh.d_br;

SELECT

WITH customer_versions AS (
    SELECT 
        BUS_ID, 
        CUST_SGMNT_CD1, 
        VRSN_NBR, 
        IS_CURR,
        LAG(CUST_SGMNT_CD1) OVER (PARTITION BY BUS_ID ORDER BY VRSN_NBR) as prev_segment
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as customer_count
FROM customer_versions
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE 
  AND prev_segment IS NOT NULL 
  AND CUST_SGMNT_CD1 <> prev_segment;

SELECT count(DISTINCT t.CUST_K)
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t

WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY t.CUST_K
HAVING count(DISTINCT d.QTR_NBR) = 4;

SELECT count(DISTINCT f_cd_dspt.cust_k)
FROM bank_dwh.f_cd_dspt

WHERE d_dspt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
AND f_cd_dspt.cust_k NOT IN (

    JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt d_wr ON f_wr_trf.bus_dt_k = d_wr.dt_k
    WHERE d_wr.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
)

WITH loan_status AS (
    SELECT 
        f.ln_id, 
        d.cal_dt,
        f.dys_pst_due
    FROM bank_dwh.f_ln_dsbrs f
    JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt d ON f.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
    WHERE d.cal_dt IN ('2024-06-30', '2025-06-30')
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT t2024.ln_id)
FROM 
    (SELECT ln_id FROM loan_status WHERE cal_dt = '2024-06-30' AND dys_pst_due = 0) t2024
JOIN 
    (SELECT ln_id FROM loan_status WHERE cal_dt = '2025-06-30' AND dys_pst_due > 30) t2025
ON t2024.ln_id = t2025.ln_id;

SELECT
    t.CCY_CD1,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.ORGNL_AMT) AS median_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY t.CCY_CD1;

WITH MonthlyLastSnapshot AS (
    SELECT 
        d.MTH_NBR,
        MAX(d.DT_K) AS last_dt_k
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT 
    mls.MTH_NBR,
    SUM(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS total_closing_balance
FROM MonthlyLastSnapshot mls
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f ON mls.last_dt_k = f.BUS_DT_K
GROUP BY mls.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY mls.MTH_NBR;

SELECT

WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment_code,
        c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id,
        SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_amount
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        segment_code,
        customer_business_id,
        total_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment_code ORDER BY total_amount DESC) as rank_pos
    FROM customer_totals
)
SELECT 
    segment_code,
    customer_business_id,
    total_amount
FROM ranked_customers
WHERE rank_pos <= 3
ORDER BY segment_code, total_amount DESC;

SELECT

WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025

SELECT

WHERE t1.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_auth_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
    c.bus_id,
    SUM(f.stlm_amt) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.f_wr_trf f
JOIN bank_dwh.d_cust c ON f.cust_k = c.cust_k
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt d ON f.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP BY c.bus_id
ORDER BY total_wire_transfer_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    f.CCY_CD1,
    SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT w.CUST_K)
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_w ON w.BUS_DT_K = d_w.DT_K
WHERE d_w.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
AND w.CUST_K IN (
    SELECT a.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_a ON a.BUS_DT_K = d_a.DT_K
    WHERE d_a.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT count(*) FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT d.cal_yr_nbr AS year, COUNT(f.wr_trf_f_k) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.f_wr_trf f
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt d ON f.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.cal_yr_nbr
ORDER BY d.cal_yr_nbr;

/* Note: No metric for 'Customer Lifetime Value' (CLV) is defined in the supplied metadata. As a proxy, using the average of ESTMT_ASSTS_AMT (Estimated Assets Amount) per segment. Using only the current version of each customer. */
SELECT
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
    AVG(ESTMT_ASSTS_AMT) AS avg_lifetime_value
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

/* Assumption: No employee-specific table is provided in the metadata. Using D_CUST.ANNL_INCM_AMT as a proxy for employee salary for individuals linked to branches via account balance facts. */
SELECT
    br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    AVG(cust.ANNL_INCM_AMT) AS average_salary
FROM bank_dwh.D_BR br
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D fab ON br.BR_K = fab.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST cust ON fab.CUST_K = cust.CUST_K
GROUP BY br.DSPLY_NM;

/* Assumption: No gender column exists in D_CUST or D_PTY; searching for a gender-related attribute. Since no such column was found in the metadata, this query cannot be completed without knowing which column represents gender. */

DELETE FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE CUST_K IN (
    SELECT CUST_K
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            CUST_K, 
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BUS_ID ORDER BY INGST_AT DESC, CUST_K DESC) as row_idx
        FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
    ) t
    WHERE t.row_idx > 1
);
DROP TABLE bank_dwh.F_CMPLT;
SELECT DSPLY_NM FROM bank_dwh.D_BR;

INSERT INTO bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D (BUS_DT_K, CCY_CD1, MID_RT)
SELECT
    d.DT_K,
    'USD',
    1.10
FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-12-31';

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.is_wknd = TRUE) AS weekend_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.is_wknd = FALSE) AS weekday_count
FROM bank_dwh.f_atm_txn f
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt d
  ON f.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025;

SELECT count(DISTINCT b1.ACCT_K) AS account_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D b1
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d1 ON b1.BUS_DT_K = d1.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D b2 ON b1.ACCT_K = b2.ACCT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d2 ON b2.BUS_DT_K = d2.DT_K
WHERE d1.CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
  AND d2.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30'
  AND b1.CLSNG_BAL_AMT < b2.CLSNG_BAL_AMT * 0.9

SELECT
    f.CMPLT_CTG_K,
    AVG(EXTRACT(DAY FROM (f.RSLTN_AT - f.CNTCT_STRTD_AT))) AS avg_days_to_resolution
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.IS_RSLVD = TRUE
GROUP BY f.CMPLT_CTG_K;

SELECT count(*) FROM (
  SELECT 
    curr.BUS_ID,
    curr.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS current_segment,
    prev.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS previous_segment
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST curr
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST prev 
    ON curr.BUS_ID = prev.BUS_ID
  WHERE curr.IS_CURR = TRUE
    AND prev.VRSN_NBR = (curr.VRSN_NBR - 1)
    AND curr.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 <> prev.CUST_SGMNT_CD1
) diffs

SELECT count(DISTINCT t.CUST_K)
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY t.CUST_K
HAVING count(DISTINCT d.QTR_NBR) = 4;

SELECT count(DISTINCT d.CUST_K)
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt_d ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt_d.DT_K
WHERE dt_d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
AND d.CUST_K NOT IN (
    SELECT w.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt_w ON w.BUS_DT_K = dt_w.DT_K
    WHERE dt_w.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)

WITH loan_status AS (
    SELECT 
        f.LN_ID,
        d.CAL_DT,
        f.DYS_PST_DUE
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_DT IN ('2024-06-30', '2025-06-30')
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT l2024.LN_ID)
FROM loan_status l2024
JOIN loan_status l2025 ON l2024.LN_ID = l2025.LN_ID
WHERE l2024.CAL_DT = '2024-06-30' 
  AND l2024.DYS_PST_DUE = 0
  AND l2025.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30' 
  AND l2025.DYS_PST_DUE > 30;

SELECT
    t.CCY_CD1,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.ORGNL_AMT) AS median_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY t.CCY_CD1;

WITH monthly_last_dates AS (
    SELECT 
        MTH_NBR,
        MAX(DT_K) as last_dt_k
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
    WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY MTH_NBR
)
SELECT 
    mld.MTH_NBR,
    SUM(fab.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS total_closing_balance
FROM monthly_last_dates mld
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D fab 
    ON fab.BUS_DT_K = mld.last_dt_k
GROUP BY mld.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY mld.MTH_NBR;

SELECT
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE '2023-06-30' >= EFF_FRM_DT 
  AND '2023-06-30' <= EFF_TO_DT
GROUP BY 1

WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment_code,
        c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id,
        SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_amount
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        segment_code,
        customer_business_id,
        total_wire_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment_code ORDER BY total_wire_amount DESC) as rank_idx
    FROM customer_totals
)
SELECT 
    segment_code,
    customer_business_id,
    total_wire_amount
FROM ranked_customers
WHERE rank_idx <= 3
ORDER BY segment_code, total_wire_amount DESC;

SELECT
    f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
    (COUNT(*) * 100.0) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_percentage
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT 
    t1.mth_nbr,
    COUNT(t2.wr_trf_f_k) AS wire_transfer_count,
    SUM(COUNT(t2.wr_trf_f_k)) OVER (ORDER BY t1.mth_nbr) AS running_total
FROM bank_dwh.d_dt t1
JOIN bank_dwh.f_wr_trf t2 ON t1.dt_k = t2.bus_dt_k
WHERE t1.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP BY t1.mth_nbr
ORDER BY t1.mth_nbr;

SELECT
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN trf.ORGNL_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN trf.ORGNL_AMT
            ELSE trf.ORGNL_AMT / fx.MID_RT
        END
    ) AS total_wire_transfer_amount_eur
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF trf
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt 
    ON trf.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx 
    ON trf.BUS_DT_K = fx.BUS_DT_K 
    AND trf.CCY_K = fx.CCY_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND (trf.ORGNL_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' OR fx.QUOT_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR');

SELECT 
    t1.MTH_NBR, 
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.AUTH_RSLT_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS declined_share
FROM bank_dwh.D_DT t1
JOIN bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE t2 ON t1.DT_K = t2.BUS_DT_K
WHERE t1.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY t1.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY declined_share DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    t2.CCY_NM,
    SUM(t1.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t1
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY t2
    ON t1.CCY_K = t2.CCY_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT t3
    ON t1.BUS_DT_K = t3.DT_K
WHERE t3.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY t2.CCY_NM

cost_scope: Benchmark phase only; startup excluded. Shared GPU total is recorded in the local suite manifest.
serving_note: One shared 32k server per model, prefix caching enabled for both modes; non-thinking BF16. Full runs use 16 concurrent questions, compatibility runs use 4.
